summary: Made and shipped L-20261023-01, 'Why the rich borrow money and the poor pay it back' (8:19, USD, rich vs poor): five debts (car loan, card balance, mortgage, student loan, the never-ending car payment), the first long video on the shot system with a custom split-screen hook.
why: Weekly target 3, 2 made this week; Scout's top usable feed topic (2026-10-23-rich-borrow-poor-save, priority high, reference 5.9M views).

findings.title: Fact review passed on the third pass
findings.detail: Round 1: the hook mixed a 5-year car value with a 10-year house value, car depreciation said as fact, three 'most people' claims, description said six debts for five. Round 2: a stack labelled 'Borrowed' showed the house's assumed value; the hook tags lacked years and 'assumed'. All fixed.

findings.title: QA passed on the third pass
findings.detail: Round 1: hook frame 0 black, two phone labels overlapping values, three empty vault openings, a stray chart underline. Round 2: faces cut at the frame edge in phone shots, a phone title too wide. All fixed.

findings.title: The shot system needs long-format fixes
findings.detail: Close shots on stacks/phones push tags off the frame, phone text is under 30 px in wide shots, drop-in words start off-frame, flying notes' glyphs are 20 px. Worked around in the script; five items added to improvement/longform/backlog.json for the improver.

findings.title: Card example changed from the outline
findings.detail: The outline's 2% minimum ($44,200, 67 years) is an extreme case; used a 3% minimum ($35 floor): $6,746 interest over 15 years.

changes.title: Shipped L-20261023-01
changes.detail: 499 s, 136 beats, 1,902 words, liveliness median 6.03; manifest on main, mp4 on media/L-20261023-01. Thumbnail angles: warning (main), versus, question.
